curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42038-1-1.pdf (book 1, steps 1-73) and omr/instructions/42038-1-2.pdf (book 2, steps 74-114; the functions are drawn on pages 67-68 and 76, the Power Functions motor option on pages 68-75)

functions.does: The black gear on top of the frame behind the cab steers (hand of god steering): its vertical shaft turns, through 12 tooth bevel gears and two universal joints, a 12 tooth gear on the front axle's rack, which turns both front track units.
functions.source: book 1: steps 1-9 (the vertical shaft and bevel gears, pages 3-6), front axle steps 1-17 (the rack, pages 38-44), steps 47-53 (front axle fitted; step 53 on page 56 draws the gear turning and the front tracks swinging)

functions.does: With the red selector lever in position 1, the knob on top of the frame (a black axle joiner on a vertical shaft) tips the bed at the back: a 20 tooth bevel gear at the shaft's foot turns the selector shaft through a 12 tooth bevel gear, the driving ring couples one clutch gear, and through a 16 tooth idler, a shaft and two universal joints it runs the linear actuator that lifts the bed.
functions.source: book 1: steps 5-18 (the selector's shaft, clutch gears, driving ring and lever, pages 4-14; the 1:1 drawing on page 13), steps 54-57 (bed and actuator; step 57 on page 61 draws the knob, the lever and the bed tipping); book 2 pages 67-68 and 76 (the lever's two positions: 1 tips the bed)
functions.note: the ring is slid as the lever would slide it; unsure which way it must slide for position 1: the tipper's clutch gear is the one towards the back (p67), the crane's the one towards the front (p71)

functions.does: With the lever in position 2, the same knob raises and lowers the crane's boom: the other clutch gear drives, through a 20 tooth idler and a 16 tooth gear, a shaft forward to a 12 tooth bevel gear and a 20 tooth bevel gear on a vertical shaft up through the turntable's centre, and through a universal joint it runs the linear actuator that luffs the boom.
functions.source: book 1: steps 5-11 and 34-40 (the gears, and the vertical shaft through the turntable, pages 4-9 and 25-30); book 2: crane steps 1-12 and steps 106-111 (actuator and boom, pages 52-62); pages 67-68 and 76 (position 2 raises the crane)
functions.note: the ring is slid as the lever would slide it; unsure of the sign, as above

functions.does: The red selector lever beside the knob slides the driving ring between the two clutch gears: position 1 for the bed, position 2 for the crane.
functions.source: book 1: steps 10-12 (the lever and changeover catch, page 13), step 57; book 2 page 67 (the lever's two positions marked with bed and crane symbols)

functions.does: The crane slews round on its turntable behind the cab, turned by hand; a 20 tooth gear beside it meshes with the turntable's teeth.
functions.source: book 1: steps 34-40 (turntable and gear, pages 25-30); book 2 page 68 (the crane slewing, bottom right)
functions.note: unsure whether the 20 tooth gear beside the turntable (p160 32269) is meant to be turned to slew it, or only holds it

functions.does: The black gear at the crane's base winds the winch, raising and lowering the hook and its load on the string over the boom tip.
functions.source: book 2: crane step 11 (reel and string, page 57), steps 107-112 (pages 58-63); inferred: that the gear is the winch's handle

functions.does: The front and rear axles each swing side to side on a central pivot, with a shock absorber either side, so the tracks follow the ground.
functions.source: book 1: rear axle steps 11 and 47-51 (pages 9 and 44-46), front axle steps 47-53 (step 53 on page 56 draws the front axle rocking); inferred: the rear axle the same

functions.does: The shock absorbers' springs hold the axles level and spring back.
functions.skip: springs only matter under force; the axles swing freely without them

functions.does: Each of the four track units rocks on its hub, and its track runs freely round its sprocket and wheels when the truck is pushed along; nothing drives the tracks.
The cab's top tips forward on a hinge, to reach inside (where the Power Functions battery box goes).
functions.source: book 2: step 90 (page 26, the arrow); page 71 (step 3 of the motor option)
functions.note: unsure which parts form the hinged top in the model

functions.does: The steering wheel in the cab turns freely; it isn't linked to the steering.
functions.source: inferred: from the model; the book draws no link

functions.does: With the Power Functions motor fitted (sold separately, 8293), the motor turns the knob's shaft, and the lever chooses bed or crane as before.
functions.note: the model file has no motor; the knob p190 59443 is worked by hand

questions.question: Which way does each lever go for which function? The `first` amounts in this file are guesses.
